'''2011 German National Championship Dirk Friedrichs LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dirk Friedrichs]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS racing
* '''Username:''' Uber-Obi
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
